TARGET.name: NEXT_BAR_GEOMETRY_STATE
TARGET.definition: close(t+1) > high(t) + 0.15*ATR(t) -> UP_BREAK ; close(t+1) < low(t) - 0.15*ATR(t) -> DOWN_BREAK ; else INSIDE
TARGET.STRICT_CAUSALITY: FEATURE(t) -> TARGET(t+1); no TARGET(t), no FEATURE(t+1), no future aggregation / normalization / level construction

LOW_COMPLEXITY_REFERENCE.name: naive_conditional_frequency
LOW_COMPLEXITY_REFERENCE.role: sanity check ONLY; never used to select a model

WALK_FORWARD.PURGE_DERIVATION: max feature lookback from the frozen registry (ATR_PCTL rolling 480)
WALK_FORWARD.initial_training_segment: first equal segment of the usable range
WALK_FORWARD.TEST_BLOCK_DEFINITION: usable = bars[480:]; split into 4 equal parts; T1 initial train; T2/T3/T4 are test blocks 1/2/3 with expanding training

PERMUTATION_NULL.method: shuffle the candidate feature column, REFIT both models, re-test, record delta_ll
PERMUTATION_NULL.NULL_SEPARATION: PASS iff observed mean delta_ll > null p95

CRITERIA_PREREGISTERED.TIME_BLOCK_STABILITY: required; an average must never hide a negative block (task 10)

BASELINE_RULE: BASELINE = frozen V1-R2 context with the candidate's OWN fields removed (task 5); the candidate's own field must never already be inside the baseline
MULTIPLE_COMPARISON: each candidate reported independently; NO winner picking (task 23)
